pages.text: $(l)Tremor$()$(br)The Colossus Heart meter. Taking physical damage builds it, and it fades out of combat. Higher stages turn Tremor into attack damage, a smaller movement penalty, and a shockwave when enough is stored.
$(l)Heat$()$(br)The Ember Seed meter. Taking and dealing damage build it from Awakened onward, and it fades over time. More Heat means more movement speed and attack speed.
$(l)Reactive Blink$()$(br)The Nebula Lens dodge. A hit can be avoided by blinking away, and your next hit is heavily empowered.
$(l)Withering Decay$()$(br)The Void Pearl's on-hit decay. At higher stages, decayed enemies deal less damage and can be finished outright.

$(l)Hollow Dominion$()$(br)The Void Pearl's darkness aura. In low light, nearby enemies get Wither and Weakness, plus Slowness at Apex. At Transcendent and Apex it also strips their beneficial effects.
